name: Hunky City : Love as you go
source:
You move to a new city to live with your "former" stepfather. Work, make friends, and explore the thrilling world of romance in this captivating game. Are you ready for the excitement? Let the journey begin!

[From [url=https://fymm-game.itch.io/hunky-city]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你搬到一个新城市与你的“前”继父住在一起。在这款引人入胜的游戏中工作、结交朋友并探索惊心动魄的浪漫世界。你准备好迎接兴奋了吗？让旅程开始吧！

[来自[url=https://fymm-game.itch.io/hunky-city]Itch.io[/url]]
